name: Stock Market 3
description: A multi-symbol exchange simulation: a configurable universe of equities across 5 sectors plus a tradable synthetic index, all partially driven by a shared hidden macro economy, real quarterly company fundamentals and earnings with their own analyst-consensus estimates, a public economic-release calendar, and corporate actions (dividends, buybacks, splits, acquisitions, delistings) — layered onto the same real order book, matching engine, and Reg-T-style margin/short-selling as games/stock-market-2 (on by default here).
